title.narrative: Promoting Reading Society in Liberia through National Book Fairs

description.narrative: Despite the recognized benefits of fostering a culture of reading, Liberia faces challenges in promoting and sustaining a vibrant reading society. Factors such as limited access to diverse and affordable reading materials, low reading engagement levels, and a lack of community-based initiatives contribute to a diminished reading culture among the population. The absence of platforms like book fairs hinders the promotion of literacy, critical thinking, and intellectual growth. This gap not only affects individual development but also has broader implications for education, social cohesion, and cultural enrichment. Therefore, there is a pressing need to organize and promote book fairs as a means to encourage reading, improve access to a variety of literature, and cultivate a thriving reading society in Liberia. Moreover, Promoting Reading Society through Book Fairs in Liberia” revolves around the need to address the low literacy rates and lack of reading culture in Liberia. The objective is to promote a reading society by utilizing book fairs as a platform to engage the community, especially children and youth, in reading activities. This initiative aims to foster a culture of literacy, improve access to books, and encourage a love for reading among Liberians.
